Doses of dofetilide should be reduced in patients with renal impairment based on creatinine clearance (CC). Initial doses are: • CC 40 to 60 mL/minute: 250 micrograms twice daily • CC 20 to 39 mL/minute: 125 micrograms twice daily • CC below 20 mL/minute: contra-indicated Preparations Proprietary Preparations (details are given in Part 3) USA: Tikosyn.
